Method.Source:
/// <summary> /// Writes one picklist entity row to the CSV output; shared by the direct and /// intercompany-leg picklist loops so the column list is defined once. /// </summary> /// <param name = "_csvWriter">CSV writer to append the line to</param> /// <param name = "_pickListEntity">Picklist entity row to write</param> private void addPicklistEntityLine(DEVFileWriterCSV _csvWriter, METWMSPicklistEntity _pickListEntity) { _csvWriter.addContainerLine([ _pickListEntity.Customer, _pickListEntity.CutOffDay, _pickListEntity.CutOffTime, _pickListEntity.DeliveryInstructions, _pickListEntity.DispatchDay, _pickListEntity.DispatchTime, _pickListEntity.ItemId, _pickListEntity.LineNum, _pickListEntity.LotId, _pickListEntity.OrderDate, _pickListEntity.OrderNumber, _pickListEntity.OrderType, _pickListEntity.PicklistNumber, _pickListEntity.Route, _pickListEntity.RouteStop, _pickListEntity.ShippingDate, _pickListEntity.ShippingSite, _pickListEntity.ShippingWarehouse, _pickListEntity.StagingLane, _pickListEntity.Volume, _pickListEntity.Weight, _pickListEntity.WMSOrderTransRecId, _pickListEntity.WMSOrderType, _pickListEntity.CWItem, _pickListEntity.CommodityCode, _pickListEntity.Door, _pickListEntity.expeditionStatus, _pickListEntity.METPickedQtyProcessed, _pickListEntity.METPickedQtyUpdated, _pickListEntity.InternalCustomer, _pickListEntity.METPickedCases, _pickListEntity.METPickedBrokenCases, _pickListEntity.UnitShipCaseQty, _pickListEntity.BondedWarehouse, _pickListEntity.InternalCustPaymMethod, _pickListEntity.PickEaches, _pickListEntity.ReservedQty, _pickListEntity.PdsCWConversion, _pickListEntity.CaseUOM ]);
this.logIncNumberOfRecords(); }
